column2: Messy Hands Inbox. A Spectacles Lens for the moment your hands are busy.
I'm cooking. My hands are in dough. Three people text me at once, and I can't touch my phone.
I planned it with the plan-lens interview. My answers became a design brief: where the card sits, how I act on it, and five checks it must pass. Then CLAD built it in Lens Studio.
The card lies on the counter, just right of the dough. It never covers my work.
I say start. The grey dot turns green.
Who wrote? Three names. I pick Mom.
I say the gist in my own words. The assistant cleans it up, and I see it before it goes.
Every voice command has a big pinch button, so it works with dough on my fingers, and in the preview. The text is large and near white, because black shows as clear on these glasses.
LEAF tests check all five done criteria. Six of six pass.
Messy Hands Inbox. Look, speak, keep cooking.
